entry.title: Northwood Space raises $375M Series C at a $2B valuation from a16z and DFJ Growth
entry.summary: Space infrastructure company Northwood Space on Monday said it had raised $375 million in a Series C round co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and DFJ Growth, valuing the company at $2 billion.

entry.title: Ninja’s first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once
entry.summary: The Ninja Crispi Microwave stands out for its FusionCrisp technology, which combines the speed of a microwave with the crispy results you'd expect from an air fryer.

entry.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
entry.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal.

entry.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
entry.summary: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

entry.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
entry.summary: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

entry.title: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
entry.summary: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.

entry.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
entry.summary: Readwise Books combines an e-book store, reading tracker, detailed reading stats, and AI features in a bid to challenge Amazon's ecosystem.

entry.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
entry.summary: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.

entry.title: Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders
entry.summary: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.

entry.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
entry.summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

entry.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
entry.summary: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

entry.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
entry.summary: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

entry.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
entry.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

entry.title: Apple’s inventory surges 154% as memory chip costs climb
entry.summary: Apple says unprecedented memory chip costs will continue to rise, raising questions about future device prices as its inventory climbs to $14.5 billion.

entry.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
entry.summary: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

entry.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
entry.summary: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.

entry.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
entry.summary: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.

entry.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
entry.summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

entry.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
entry.summary: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

entry.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
entry.summary: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.
